description: weather_best_day — Which day this week is best for an activity at a US location. Scores each of the next 1-7 days 0-100 (GOOD/FAIR/POOR) from the official NWS forecast against activity-specific limits for temperature, rain chance, wind, overnight lows, dry-overnight curing, humidity, thunder/snow/fog and severe alerts, then ranks the days with reasons. Params: place (city/address) or lat+lon; activity = outdoor, paint, concrete, mow, run, bbq, golf, beach, hike, bike, drone, laundry, plant, carwash, roof, fish, wedding (default outdoor); optional days (1-7), min_temp, max_temp (F, daytime high), max_pop (%), max_wind (mph) to override the profile. Source: NOAA NWS (public domain). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_best_day
